notes..p1: NOT IN MAP: the registry class is literally named '.p1' (selector '.\.p1', font-size 1.125rem with laptop/mobile values, 138 uses on 30 pages incl. NavBar/Footer/CTA-Bottom components). class-rename.mjs rejects the key (NAME_RE). Proposed name once the tool accepts it: text-size-medium (check it does not exist) or text-size-large-paragraph.
notes.p3: The 4 fit-checklist item texts (1rem at every width). Its declarations equal text-size-regular at base, but text-size-regular also sets 1.148rem on mobile, so a merge would move them. A utility-shaped name (text-size-regular-fixed) fails class-audit --strict as a reimplemented utility; a custom folder_element class holding one utility's declarations is allowed (CLASS-STANDARD section 5), so it is named for its element. Whether these 4 paragraphs should take the mobile bump and merge into text-size-regular is a separate visual decision.
notes.kicker: the tagline role (Client-First text-style-tagline); it also carries colour and margin
notes.eyebrow: tagline in a bordered pill; 'eyebrow' is out of bounds per CLASS-STANDARD.md
notes.text-lh-*: line-height utilities, named from their value: text-style-line-height-1-7 = 1.7
notes.text-tracking-*: letter-spacing utilities named from their em value: text-style-letter-spacing-minus-0-04 = -0.04em
notes.text-NN-MM: responsive font-size fragments from the 2026-09-15 type-roles pass; renamed text-size-custom-NN-MM, folding them into the role classes is a separate visual decision
notes.-alternate: converter context variants (parent_child) of a class with different declarations; the variant takes -alternate
notes.generated: 399 Framework-generated colour utilities (bg-*, border-*, text-*-d-1 …) are left alone: the Framework owns and regenerates them
notes.heading-31-3: identical to heading-43-3 (both unused) but class-rename refuses a merge into a target whose CURRENT name is out of bounds; renamed instead
notes.merges: font-weight-600 = text-weight-600, text-bold = text-weight-700 (then renamed to the library text-weight-semibold/bold), font-color-white = text-color-white, active = is-active (both empty rules; the script toggles it)
notes.result: NOT IN MAP (yet): site.js does chart.querySelector('.grow-bar.result'); class-rename.mjs rewriteJs skips a class preceded by a word char (treats '.result' in '.grow-bar.result' as a property access), so renaming would leave the script on the old name and break the result-lab chart. Intended name: bar-track_result. Add it back once the engine rewrites compound selectors.
